name: Create linked tasks using the actual schema
query: Read https://notion.so/payment-spec and create implementation tasks in https://notion.so/tasks.

sources.https://notion.so/payment-spec: Support checkout with idempotency keys and signed payment webhooks. Acceptance: repeating checkout does not double charge; invalid signatures are rejected; replayed webhook events do not duplicate fulfillment. Refunds are out of scope.

success_criteria: Covers checkout idempotency, webhook signature validation, replay handling, and their tests with explicit acceptance criteria.
Uses Task and Stage from the actual schema and a valid data source parent.
Uses task IDs for task relations, not a spec ID in a relation targeting the task database.
Links tasks to the spec, preserves refunds as out of scope, and returns created task links.
Does not invent owners or dates, require a fixed task count, or mark work as started.
